svg.aria-label: CLASSROOM PROJECTS · STUCOM PELAI (DAW) — Nurse-Simulator (BACKEND · SYMFONY 7.4): RESTful backend API for hospital nurse simulation using Symfony 7.4, Doctrine ORM, Supabase PostgreSQL & CI/CD.; Nurse-Simulator-Frontend (FRONTEND · ANGULAR): Interactive hospital care web client built with Angular & TypeScript integrating the Nurse Simulator REST API (MP06/MP16).; RunAndEat (WEB PLATFORM · V1 & V2): Urban gastronomic routes & booking platform — built in vanilla PHP/MySQL/JS (v1) and modernized in Laravel 11 + Vue 3 (2.0.0).. Also from STUCOM labs: Argus-Fraud-Radar (PySpark/LightGBM), IgnacioBank (Java), MP0613_RA3_POO_Bank & PHP/XML practices.
